title: ml.get_categories

page.description:
Configures pagination.
This parameter has the `from` and `size` properties.

from.description: Skips the specified number of categories.

partition_field_value.description: Only return categories for the specified partition.

size.description: Specifies the maximum number of categories to obtain.

job_id.description: Identifier for the anomaly detection job.

category_id.description:
Identifier for the category, which is unique in the job. If you specify
neither the category ID nor the partition_field_value, the API returns
information about all categories. If you specify only the
partition_field_value, it returns information about all categories for
the specified partition.

description: Get anomaly detection job results for categories.
